data.name: UmaMahesh
data.long_meaning: The name UmaMahesh is a combination of two names - Uma and Mahesh. Uma represents the Goddess Parvati, who is the consort of Lord Shiva. Mahesh refers to Lord Shiva. Therefore, UmaMahesh can be interpreted as the union of Goddess Parvati and Lord Shiva.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name UmaMahesh is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring blessings of love, fertility, and power. It is also considered an auspicious name for a baby as it represents the divine union of Shiva and Parvati.
